rules: Acceptance Contract is introduced in the control-only dispatch commit and is immutable afterwards.
Every predicate must link bidirectionally to one or more Requirement IDs extracted from the immutable Mission Specification.
Every machine-inferred semantic tag must be declared and covered by at least one predicate.
Every machine-required domain partition for a semantic tag must be covered before completion.
Universal predicates require more than one partition and cannot be proven by a single happy-path example.
MEDIUM+ requires verifier-owned adversarial evidence and signed external review.
Predicate PASS is derived from predicate coverage; prose verdict alone is insufficient.
Every predicate partition owns one or more pre-implementation oracle IDs/statements; verifier cases must bind and observe those exact oracles at runtime.
Every oracle declares observation_kind. raises-oracles also declare expected_exception; runtime structured observation must match the pre-dispatch oracle contract.
